rv.q: This visually rich, wonderfully paced, aurally thrilling production keeps us wide-eyed and on tenterhooks for more than two hours.

Much the same can be said about Frozen . The MCC Theater production of Bryony Lavery's play, which just transferred to Circle in the Square, is a welcome glimmer of something unique and different in an otherwise fairly stolid season.

tn.cat: Best Featured Actor in a Play

cn.t: Critics praise this visually stunning production for its eye-popping stagecraft and strong ensemble performances, calling it a wonderfully paced, aurally thrilling spectacle that captivates audiences despite a familiar story.
